summary: Link-integrity sweep across all 9 division pages + new sections (portfolio, course detail, guest form, store checkout, studios CMS projects). Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass (18 existing + 12 new for portfolio_projects, studios_projects, jobs, products, podcast_episodes, orders, course detail, guest-via-contact). Frontend: found and fixed 2 hard compile errors that were making the whole app un-buildable before the sweep began, then completed link sweep — every link tested resolves to a working non-empty page. Studios CMS project grid renders empty because backend seed() does not seed the studios_projects collection (task expected 2 seeded projects).

minor.issue: Collection is registered and endpoint returns [], but backend seed() never populates studios_projects. Task requirement said 2 studios projects should be seeded above the static case studies. Studios page currently shows only the 4 static case studies — the CMS grid section renders nothing.
Still uses allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL] which is now correct — no action.

ui_bugs.issue: File was missing the closing '}' of the GuestForm function — caused a webpack/babel parse error and the entire frontend failed to compile. Fixed by appending '}'.
Used <Link> in JSX without importing it from react-router-dom — /courses page would throw ReferenceError at runtime. Fixed by adding the import.

link_sweep_results.creative_agency_service_cards: 11/11 resolve to a real ServiceDetail page (ServiceDetail fallback slugify(name)===slug covers the 10 categories whose SERVICE_DETAILS key differs from slugify(cat name)).
link_sweep_results.portfolio_filter_chips: 11 chips all clickable; filter logic runs without error.
link_sweep_results.portfolio_project_cards: 2/2 seeded projects → /creative-agency/work/:id case study pages render Brief/Challenge/Strategy/Execution/Outcome + Start a Project CTA.
link_sweep_results.studios_service_boxes_and_audio_link: 11 studio service boxes render; studios-audio-link → /creative-agency/services/audio-voice-and-music resolves via ServiceDetail slug fallback.
link_sweep_results.studios_cms_projects_grid: EMPTY — backend seed missing studios_projects (see backend_issues).
link_sweep_results.academy_instrument_cards: 5/5 instrument pages load; Free Trial anchor links resolve.
link_sweep_results.courses_category_chips_and_cards: 7 chips clickable; 7 course cards → /courses/:id all render instructor/duration/mode/level/price sidebar + Register Interest CTA.
link_sweep_results.podcast_guest_form: guest-name/email/topic/message → guest-submit → guest-success shown; record persisted to contact_enquiries with enquiry_type='Podcast — Become a Guest' (verified via admin GET).
link_sweep_results.store: 9 category chips clickable; 3 product cards → /store/:id render; add-to-cart increments count; cart panel opens; checkout button navigates to /store/checkout; place order → /store/order/:id renders with order_no and Status: Pending Payment.
link_sweep_results.admin_login_regression: Login page loads at /admin (verified visually + POST /api/auth/login returns valid JWT in backend suite).

action_items: Add studios_projects seeding to backend/server.py seed() — 2 projects with fields id/name/category/description matching what Studios.jsx renders. This is explicitly called out in the review request.

(Out of scope but noted from prior iteration) Legal pages /privacy /terms /refund /shipping are referenced by the footer but no routes exist — they 404 silently by falling through the layout Route. Not covered in this sweep.
critical_code_review_comments: CreativeAgency.jsx portfolio filter is functional but the .split(' ').some(() => ...) is dead-code weirdness — the some() callback ignores its argument so it collapses to a single boolean; readability nit, no functional bug.

ServiceDetail.jsx correctly falls back on slugify(name)===slug — good; but the SERVICE_DETAILS keys are inconsistent with slugify (e.g. 'brand-strategy-consultation' vs 'brand-strategy-and-consultation'). Recommend normalizing keys to slugify(name) to remove the need for the Object.values scan.
Podcast.jsx / Courses.jsx compile bugs caught here — please add a lint pass (eslint --max-warnings 0) to CI to prevent unbuildable commits reaching preview.
seed() has grown large — worth splitting into per-collection seed helpers if any more content types are added.
seed_data_creation: None created outside test fixtures. Note: backend seed() populates admin + 5 courses + 1 event + 3 articles + 2 jobs + 2 podcast episodes + 3 products + 2 portfolio_projects. It does NOT seed studios_projects — action required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 division pages, service detail slug fallback, portfolio detail, course detail, guest form, store→checkout→order flow verified. If main agent adds studios_projects seed, just visit /studios and confirm 2 project cards render above the 4 static case studies (data-testid='studios-project-<uuid>').
rca of the issue: Compile failures RCA: Podcast.jsx GuestForm inline function was written without its closing brace (last line was ');' terminating the return statement of GuestForm, but no '}' closed the function body). Courses.jsx was refactored to use <Link> for card navigation but the import of Link from react-router-dom was not added. Both fixed with minimal edits and frontend recompiled successfully. Studios CMS-empty RCA: seed() in backend/server.py has an if-block for portfolio_projects but no matching block for studios_projects, so the collection stays empty forever unless populated via /api/admin/studios_projects POST — needs a seed block.
